rationale: SCOPE was supplied (BGSTAB), so per kiwi-srs §6.3 only conflict/update were candidates. The Phase 1 existing-SRS analyst read REL-BGSTAB-020 in full and found it fixes the same failure signature by a mechanism that is per-process state (a promise chain on flushToDisk), which cannot observe a second process. It is correct and implemented for its own narrower scope, so it is neither contradicted (conflict) nor replaced (update). The cross-process case is therefore additive: new-feature carrying an `extends` trace link to REL-BGSTAB-020.

affected_existing_reqs.diff_summary: REL-BGSTAB-020 serializes flushToDisk within one process. This requirement covers the case its mechanism cannot reach: two processes in one checkout. Its status and stability are unchanged.

scope_boundary_note: The Phase 1 SRS analyst flagged the scope's Out-of-Scope items about port 2002 and about terminating node processes as things a two-instance reproduction would collide with. This requirement's verification is unit-level — two service instances inside one node:test process, plus fault injection at the fs boundary — and starts no server, so no boundary item is touched and no §0.G4 gate fires.
multi_aspect_note: Kept as one requirement rather than split per store. The four writers share one code shape and the fix is one shared helper; splitting would produce four requirements with identical statements and identical evidence. AC-7 carries the all-four-stores obligation so the merge does not lose it.
